name: Room with Lina
source:
Kanzaki Lina helped main hero when he was got drunk under the rain. She continues to live in his house with some purpose. By becoming friends he will know the secret of Lina.

[Edited From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation: 神崎莉奈在主人公淋雨喝醉时帮助了他。她带着某种目的继续住在他家里。通过成为朋友，他将了解莉奈的秘密。
